units.source_text: 金花赶忙伸手，捡起视若珍宝的十字架，

en.t: Jinhua hurriedly reached out and picked up the cross she treasured like a precious jewel,

units.source_text: 无意中，她看见了十字架上受难的基督像。

en.t: By chance, she saw the figure of Christ suffering on the cross.

units.source_text: 难以置信的是，基督的脸和对面外国客人的脸一摸一样！

en.t: Incredibly, Christ's face was exactly the same as the face of the foreign guest opposite her!
